description.value: Rosemary Brown Recreation Centre is a year-round City of Burnaby multi-sport facility anchored by two NHL-sized ice rinks seating 263 and 148 spectators respectively. The centre hosts public skating, hockey leagues, figure skating, ringette, and in the off-season converts to dry-floor sports including pickleball and lacrosse. Named after a pioneering BC politician and social activist, it functions as a busy community hub on Burnaby's south slope.
